title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Concealing or Disguising Criminal Proceeds and the Proceeds from Criminal Gains

articles.content_en:
Article 1 The term "crime proceeds" as provided in Article 312 of the Criminal Law refers to the stolen money, stolen goods, or other property interests obtained through crime; the term "income from crime proceeds" refers to property interests such as fruits derived from crime proceeds.
The term "other methods" as provided in Article 312 of the Criminal Law includes any means of conduct sufficient to conceal or disguise crime proceeds and income therefrom, such as intermediating in buying and selling, receiving, holding, using, processing, providing capital accounts, converting property into cash, financial instruments, or marketable securities, transferring funds through transfer or other payment settlement methods, cross-border transfer of assets, etc.

Article 2 The term "knowingly" as provided in Article 312 of the Criminal Law includes knowing or should have known. A comprehensive examination and determination shall be made based on the information contacted or received by the actor, the circumstances of handling others' crime proceeds and income therefrom, the types and amounts of crime proceeds and income therefrom, the methods of transfer or conversion of crime proceeds and income therefrom, abnormalities in transaction behaviors and capital accounts, combined with the actor's professional experience, relationship with the upstream offender, and his confession and defense.

Article 3 When handling criminal cases of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom, the nature and social harm of the upstream crime, the circumstances and consequences of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom, and the extent of obstruction of judicial order shall be comprehensively considered, and conviction and punishment shall be made according to law.

Article 6 The amount of concealed or disguised crime proceeds and income therefrom shall be calculated based on the time when the act of concealing or disguising is committed. If the purchase price or the price for selling on behalf of the goods is higher than their actual value, the price at which they were purchased or sold on behalf shall be used for calculation.
Where acts of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom are committed multiple times, and no administrative penalty has been imposed, and prosecution shall be pursued according to law, the amounts of crime proceeds and income therefrom shall be calculated cumulatively.

Article 7 Where a person colludes with an actor of theft, robbery, fraud, snatching, or the like in advance, and conceals or disguises crime proceeds and income therefrom, and a crime is constituted, he shall be punished as an accomplice to the crime of theft, robbery, fraud, snatching, or the like respectively.

Article 8 Where a person commits theft, robbery, fraud, snatching, or the like against crime proceeds and income therefrom, and a crime is constituted, he shall be convicted and punished for the crime of theft, robbery, fraud, snatching, or the like respectively.

Article 9 Where a person knowingly conceals or disguises crime proceeds and income therefrom, and constitutes the crime of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom, and at the same time constitutes another crime, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provision that imposes a heavier punishment.

Article 10 The determination of the crime of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom is premised on the existence of the facts of the upstream crime.
If the facts of the upstream crime have been verified to be true, but the actor has not yet been brought to justice, or if criminal liability is not pursued according to law due to the actor's death, lack of capacity for criminal liability, or other reasons, it shall not affect the determination of the crime of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom.

Article 11 Where a unit commits the crime of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom, in accordance with the conviction and sentencing standards for the corresponding natural person crime provided in this Interpretation, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the directly responsible supervisors and other directly liable persons shall be convicted and punished.
Where an act of concealing or disguising crime proceeds and income therefrom is committed by usurping the name of a unit, and the illegal gains are distributed privately by the actors, the actor shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law and judicial interpretations concerning natural person crimes.

Article 12 This Interpretation shall come into force on August 26, 2025. The Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Concealing or Disguising Crime Proceeds and Income Therefrom (Fa Shi [2015] No. 11) and the Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Amending the Interpretation on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Concealing or Disguising Crime Proceeds and Income Therefrom (Fa Shi [2021] No. 8) shall be abolished simultaneously. If the judicial interpretations previously issued by the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate are inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
